src/v2/core/invariants/assertions.ts#236.assessment: REAL GAP (the interpolation error-bar invariant). With a minus sign in the norm, an error that is mostly along z gives a negative radicand, the square root is NaN, NaN > bar is false, and the invariant stays silent. The tests never present a failing case with error on more than one axis.
